verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas offers project Checkpoints for snapshot/rollback and Archive/Restore, and community reports mention local-sync workflows that let developers work outside the hosted production project, but there is no documented dedicated sandbox/staging environment for AI agents to test against before touching production data — the MCP server explicitly connects to and modifies an 'open Editor session' directly. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging project mode, isolation guarantees for AI-driven edits, and first-party documentation of a non-production test environment.
